verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents its own outbound webhooks: automation rules can trigger webhooks, and threshold alerts on run count, cost, errors, feedback score and latency can be routed to any HTTP endpoint via webhook. A programmatic consumer can therefore register and receive event callbacks. The evidence is only brief doc mentions, though, with no detail on the webhook mechanism itself or independent confirmation. Missing for 10: a documented event catalog beyond alerts and rules, payload schema, signing/verification and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
